# Undoing an import, and past imports

Every import, bulk edit and change through MCP is one entry in the change log that can be undone as a whole by whoever made it or an admin; Undo says first which rows changed since and will stay, and why.

## The rule

**One entry.** An import's summary change (`action: 'imported'`, its `entityId` the import's id) keeps what every record it wrote was before (`undo`), its Via, and for a file its **File** (the name) and **Rows** ("654 changed, 397 unchanged, 5 left out") diffs. Every row's change carries the import's id. `pastImports(changes)` lists the summaries newest first, each with the undo entry if it has been undone. Activity folds an import's rows under its summary (`foldImports`): a row folds only when its summary is in the same list, so a search that finds the row alone still shows it, and a goal's own history never folds.

**Who.** Whoever made it, or an admin (`canUndoImport`); once.

**What Undo does.** Every row goes back as it was before the import: a goal or check-in it added is deleted, one it changed gets its earlier version back, a person it added goes again unless they are in use since (they have done something, own a goal, lead a team, sit in a review or have an ask), and a team it added goes once nothing sits in it. Every kind put back counts: an import that only changed a team objective puts back one row. A goal Undo deletes leaves the tree as a deleted goal does: what fed it moves up to what it fed, other goals stop listing it, and its open asks are withdrawn, even when the goal that fed it changed since. A row changed by anything after the import **stays as it is**, with why, when and by whom (`KeptRow`), from the latest change that touched it: "{who} posted a check-in for week {w} on {date}", "Its {field} was changed on {date}", "The check-in was corrected on {date}", "{name} has made changes since". A goal the import added stays when a check-in has been posted on it since.

**Before it.** `undoPreview(x, importId)` is `undoImport` without the commit: `{ restores, skipped }`, the same numbers and reasons Undo then gives. A screen and the MCP tool (`undo_import` with `dry_run`) say it before anything is undone; when nothing can go back, they say "Nothing left to undo" (`nothingToUndo`: "Nothing to undo: it changed no rows." when it wrote none), and `undoImport` refuses rather than mark it undone.

## Worked examples

Each is run against the real rule by `src/spec/spec.test.ts`: the result is what the code gives.

| Given | The rule gives |
|---|---|
| Amara loads a file adding two goals for Rhea; later Rhea checks in on the first. Undo is previewed. | `1 row goes back; stays: Pipeline cache hit rate: Rhea Kapoor posted a check-in for week 45 on 5 Nov` |
| A file’s import summary, by its name. | `goals.xlsx · 1 changed, 0 unchanged` |

## Not self-explanatory

- **Not self-explanatory:** Past imports’ list bar (When, Who, How) waits for the find spec’s FS2; until then it is found by search only.

## Where it lives

- [src/domain/removal.ts](../../../src/domain/removal.ts): `undoImport`, `undoPreview`, `pastImports`, `importName`, `canUndoImport`
- [src/domain/activity.ts](../../../src/domain/activity.ts): `foldImports`

## Requirements

- `IMPORT-UNDO`: Every import, bulk edit and bulk change through MCP is one line in Past imports and one entry in Activity, and can be undone as a whole by whoever made it or an admin. Undo says beforehand which rows have changed since and will stay.

## Tests that check it

### [src/domain/removal.test.ts](../../../src/domain/removal.test.ts)

- removing, archiving and undoing › marks someone as left: their goals and open asks are handed over first, and they leave every list
- removing, archiving and undoing › deletes someone with no history outright, and refuses anyone with history
- removing, archiving and undoing › stops a goal with history: what fed it moves up, its open asks are withdrawn, and it leaves every list but keeps its page
- removing, archiving and undoing › stops counting a deleted goal on its team’s card, as the Board does (backlog N)
- removing, archiving and undoing › deletes a goal with no check-ins, and an admin restores it later
- removing, archiving and undoing › deletes a check-in only while it is the latest; the status falls back to the one before
- removing, archiving and undoing › ends a review that was held, deletes one that never was, and edits and removes comments and notes
- removing, archiving and undoing › undoes an import: every row back as it was, rows changed since skipped and listed
- removing, archiving and undoing › round trip: removes and restores every kind of record, leaving nothing orphaned or lost

### [src/domain/importUndo.test.ts](../../../src/domain/importUndo.test.ts)

- undoing an import (rule 9) › keeps the file’s name and its rows on the summary
- undoing an import (rule 9) › names a bulk change by where it was made
- undoing an import (rule 9) › says beforehand what Undo does, and a row changed since stays, with who and when
- undoing an import (rule 9) › a field changed since says which
- undo puts back every kind, and leaves nothing hanging (IM4 review) › an import that only changes a team can be undone, and counts the team
- undo puts back every kind, and leaves nothing hanging (IM4 review) › says plainly when an import changed nothing, and refuses to mark it undone
- undo puts back every kind, and leaves nothing hanging (IM4 review) › a goal changed since that fed one Undo deletes moves up, as deleting it would
- undo puts back every kind, and leaves nothing hanging (IM4 review) › someone the import added stays while they lead a team, sit in a review or have an ask
- undo puts back every kind, and leaves nothing hanging (IM4 review) › names a corrected check-in and a bulk edit on People by what they are
- Activity folds an import’s rows under it (spec 2.7) › folds rows whose summary is listed, and leaves a row found alone
